fusions.name: Seeding Bite
fusions.desc: A rotting bite that deals 13 damage and makes the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Ripening
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds. Each bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Mulch Bed
fusions.desc: Raises a bed of spores where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Creeping Colony
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
